aesthetic: Concrete Ledger — a Swiss-editorial system built on raw tension: warm-white paper stock carries near-black concrete type, titles are anchored hard to the right margin while the left half breathes as deliberate vacancy.
chromaticArc: Slides 1–11 hold on Bone Stock; slide 12 drops to Pressed Concrete (first divider); slides 13–23 shift to Raw Linen warmth; slide 24 returns to Pressed Concrete (second divider); slides 25–34 revert to Bone Stock with the Single Shard red fired exactly once on slide 28; slides 35–36 close on a final Pressed Concrete divider before slides 37–38 surface back to Bone Stock — three full light/dark crossings.
gridStrategy: Titles default to col 32–58 (right-anchored hard edge) on 70% of slides; every fifth slide rotates to a narrow col 0–18 sidebar or a centred col 14–44 column, providing rhythmic relief while the left half of the grid functions as load-bearing white space throughout.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Georgia appears on 5–6 slides (~15%) carrying long-form pull quotes or dense analytical body text — set at weight 400 with tracking 0.04em — introducing tactile warmth against the otherwise clinical Swiss grid.

accentStrategy: Thin 1px horizontal rule lines (type: 'line') divide title and body zones on 40% of slides; a single full-bleed accent bar in Single Shard red (#C03A2B, span 60, rowSpan 1) appears exactly once as a horizontal slash on the central thesis slide.
